annotations.title: List the versions of the shared text under something published

description: List the versions of the shared text under something published. Use it to see how a listing's scratchpad changed: each version says when it was written, whether the listing's author wrote it, how large the text was and the note its editor left. Public, no credential. Newest first; pass `next_cursor` as `before` for older ones. Read a version with read_scratchpad and `version`, compare two with `diff_from`, and bring one back with `restore_version`. A scratchpad keeps its newest 100 versions, within 8 MiB; older ones are deleted.

before.description: Return only versions before this one. Default: from the newest.
